To keep things efficient, I’m prepared to start my offer in the $9,500 range. As instructed by my buying principles, that number will be adjusted downward accordingly if your records or the inspection reveal any deferred maintenance, known issues, or costly upcoming repairs. Looking forward to your transparency and response.
